identity.name: DHFR replica ensembles on one GPU: sequential versus concurrent MPS
identity.relationship: Fixed-work eight-replica adaptation specified by supplied brief; published throughput study uses fixed-time runs, not this driver.

outcome_definition.primary: Minimize elapsed wall time for eight independent 25000-step replicas on one GPU while retaining per-replica scientific outcomes.
scientific_outputs: per-replica potential-energy series sampled every 250 steps

citations.description: Supplied fixed-work ensemble specification and complete sequential driver; not an independent publication.
Public executable PME benchmark; retrieved successfully.
Hsu, Clark, Paulsen. Maximizing OpenMM Molecular Dynamics Throughput with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service. NVIDIA Technical Blog, 2025-06-04.

source_licences_and_intended_use_permiss.intended_use: Local scientific benchmarking, execution and modification.

software.component: OpenMM API, Reference and CPU platforms

data.license: Repository distribution; no separate PDB-specific licence identified.
data.permission_evidence: Brief explicitly states local running and modification permitted; PDB and force fields distributed in OpenMM repository.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image identity, GPU, driver, Python, glibc and MPS availability not supplied or inspected; no CUDA reproduction performed.
provisional_feasibility_evidence: Pinned CUDA plugin has Linux x86_64 wheels for glibc 2.27/2.28+ (PyPI).
Brief specifies CUDA 12-compatible NVIDIA driver and Python 3.10-3.13.
Single GPU required; MPS needed for proposed concurrent method.

size.scope: PDB plus the two directly required XML files; excludes software/runtime.
size.reason: No published peak host/device memory for eight concurrent replicas; small coordinate file alone cannot determine total size.

scoring.performance: Sequential total_wall_s / concurrent ensemble total_wall_s, same eight replicas, seeds and single GPU.
scoring.scientific_correctness: Brief predicts identical energy series for matched seeds and hardware; fallback compares mean-energy differences to sequential run-to-run variation.
scoring.reason: No independently published acceptance criterion for fixed-work ensemble or energy differences; fallback variation is unmeasured and has no defined statistical protocol.
scoring.reference_policy: Published fixed-time throughput is contextual, not a pass/fail target for fixed-work ensemble.
scoring.prediction_policy: Brief speedup predictions are hypotheses, not independent anchors.

repeatability.seed_usage: Each seed initializes both velocities and integrator random stream.
repeatability.repeat_count_reason: Brief provides no repeated-trial count or timing aggregation rule.
repeatability.determinism_caveat: DeterministicForces documents force reproducibility, not verified bit-identical stochastic trajectories under concurrent scheduling; documentation also cautions about single-precision CUDA PME determinism.

search_reason: No benchmark search or substitution; directly inspected sources named by brief.
